allocation: No call to stable allocator and no record/registry/lifecycle/alias-table edits. Different lexical scopes may independently resolve to one existing MIM owner; different projected addresses do not assert distinct substances.
canonical_json: json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False); no Unicode normalization, case folding, label normalization, occurrence sorting/deduplication or transport-path substitution inside the original object.
declaration_binding: Carry projection_declaration_json containing the ENTIRE exact canonical UTF-8 final declaration text in every CM projected node, together with its SHA256 and actual input path. Native payload.source_row hashes that full text, not only an opaque reference. Also bind the exact declaration file in native request inputs and both reviews source.inputs. No new top-level request key or mandatory native parser extension.
declaration_file_encoding: Final declaration is UTF-8 canonical JSON using the stated canonical_json function, without a trailing newline. projection_declaration_json is that exact decoded text, so its UTF-8 SHA256 equals the declared file SHA256. The final declaration contains the derivation formula but not its own hash or generated case identifiers.
denotation: A proposed material-concept reference whose scope is the complete immutable original lexical case and every captured material use. Constructing the reference asserts neither a unique material nor distinction from other projected references. Only a genuine same-material whole-scope judgment can support its exact link to a current MIM owner.
name: CultureMech complete-case material reference projection
native_contract: reviewed-source-bindings-v1 unchanged; extra node/occurrence columns and ordinary native input refs carry declaration/provenance.
noncircular_scope: No subsequently selected owner, MIM ID, disposition, preferred owner label, scientific classification or review result enters ID derivation. Any MIM/external annotations already in the original source case remain verbatim in that original object and its digest; they are evidence, not target selection.
origin: Generated by MIM from the frozen CultureMech lexical-case/whole-occurrence source artifact; not assigned by CultureMech or an ontology authority.

original_case_transport.acceptance: Reconstruct original top-level object plus ordered original occurrence list, require equality and exact full-case canonical hash; native parser limit unchanged
original_case_transport.declaration: Entire exact canonical declaration text remains inline and explicitly bound as a file by both actual reviews
original_case_transport.node: original_case_without_occurrences_json contains every original key except occurrences; original_case_sha256 is unchanged complete canonical case hash; original_occurrence_count explicit
original_case_transport.occurrences: Every complete exact original object in mandatory occurrence TSV, original case/occurrence order and multiplicity retained

original_data_invariant: Retain all1330 CM_NAME keys, source_case_id/raw_source_label/source_label, source_identity_claimed:false and all2911 original occurrence objects/CM_OCC IDs, annotations, recipe IDs, source file hashes, paths and locators verbatim.

original_source_scope.status: Frozen source provenance, not an assertion of material identity or a newly acquired source.

review_boundary: One whole source case per projected reference. No per-occurrence split, supplier/name-based split, positive subset, or omitted ambiguity. Ambiguous or unsupported whole scopes remain WITHHOLD; ownerless scopes have no SSSOM row and remain in source-decisions/companion accounting.
uri_status: Proposed MIM-owned project URI path; no registration, deployed page or resolver availability is claimed.
versioning: Same exact declaration and immutable original case give the same projected reference. Any denotation/declaration or original membership/payload change yields a different reference; never mutate old bytes or redirect the old reference. Changing only current owner, scientific verdict or transport location does not alter the source reference. This is a versioned evidence-scope address, not a permanent MIM record ID.
